lines.meet: I'm Mariana, a priest, and a radiation therapist before that. I'll tell you what I'm going to do before I do it, so nothing's a surprise.
lines.meet_neighbour: Ariden's Watch, of course, I'm in the infirmary there. I'm Mariana, and I've probably checked your readings already.
lines.ask_home: Which city's yours? I keep a note of everybody's, it helps me remember birthdays.
lines.ask_work: And before this, what was your field? I'm always interested in how people were trained.
lines.answer_home: Monterrey, in the north of Mexico. My father worked in the steelworks and my mother taught school.
lines.answer_work: Radiation therapist, ten years at a cancer centre. I lined up beams to the millimetre so they hit the tumour and nothing else.
lines.chat_food: My brother Beto's tacos from his stand by the stadium, on a match day. He fed half of Monterrey, and he always saved me the good ones.
lines.chat_sleep: I'm asleep by ten and up at five to run. It's the most reliable thing about me, and I'm proud of it.
lines.chat_missing: Running at five in the morning, before the city woke up, along the river. Here I run where nothing glows, when I can find it.
lines.chat_here: The priests in Orgrimmar said I prayed like an accountant, and I took it as a compliment. I aim the Light the way I aimed a beam.
lines.tease_quiet: You're my easiest patient, {name}, you never complain about anything. I'm suspicious of that.
lines.tease_talker: You've narrated the whole walk, {name}. I could write it up as a case history.
lines.tease_careful: Measure twice and cut once, {name}, that's you exactly. I'd let you line up a beam.
lines.tease_bold: Your dose of caution is well below the therapeutic range, {name}. I'm prescribing more.
lines.tease_any: I've started a chart for you, {name}. It's mostly notes saying you didn't listen to me.
lines.tease_back: Ha, all right, {name}, I'll write that one in my log.
lines.take_it_kindly: Fair, {name}, and accurate, and I accept it.
lines.bristle: I'd ask you not to make light of that, {name}. I've seen too much of it.
lines.apologise: I put that poorly, and I'm sorry. I'm usually careful about how I say things.
lines.double_down: I'm standing by that one. I don't guess, and I didn't guess then.
lines.needle_quiet: If something's wrong, I need to hear it. I can't treat what you won't report.
lines.needle_talker: Please stop talking while I'm working on somebody. It's hard to aim with commentary.
lines.needle_careful: You've hesitated long enough to make it worse. Treatment delayed is treatment failed.
lines.needle_bold: You guess, every time, and you guess badly. I've stopped being surprised by it.
lines.needle_any: You skip what you're told to do, and then you wonder why it didn't work.
lines.bite_back: I've aimed beams to the millimetre for ten years. Imprecise is the one thing I'm not.
lines.hurt: That one hurt a little, I'll admit it. I'll write it down and think about it.
lines.laugh_off: I've had doctors say worse who didn't explain anything. You're nearly as bad, and I've survived them.
lines.confide: {name}, at the cancer centre we had a little brass bell by the door. On a patient's last day of treatment they rang it, and the whole floor clapped. I remember the bell more than anything.
lines.listen: I'm listening carefully, {name}, and I'll remember all of it. That's what I do.
lines.look_out: Keep inside my range in there, {name}, close enough for me to reach.
lines.deflect: It's minor, {name}, I've checked. Treat the others before me.
lines.check_in: Tell me what happened, {name}, step by step, and where it hurts.
lines.blame: Somebody guessed in there instead of knowing, and the guess was wrong.
lines.thank: My readings were very bad there, and you fixed them. Thank you, I'm grateful.
lines.brush_off: That's what I'm here for. Lie still a minute and let it settle.
lines.worry: Hold still, {name}, please. I need to check you properly before you move.
lines.handed_down: I think this was issued to you first. I'll log it, and you'll get it back.
lines.hand_fine: You keep it, please, it's more use to you. I've got my log, and that's enough.
lines.hand_sulk: I'd have agreed if I'd been asked first. I like to be asked.
lines.turn_friendly: I've started remembering your birthday, {name}, without trying. That's how I know.
lines.turn_friends: If I ever ring a bell for somebody here, {name}, I'd want you there. You're one of mine now.
lines.turn_grating: It isn't going well between us, I've noticed. I'll keep it professional.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll treat you, because I treat everyone, and I won't pretend there's more to it.
lines.make_up: My assessment of you was wrong, {name}, and I'd like to correct it.
lines.defend: That isn't accurate, and it isn't kind. Leave {name} out of it.
lines.friend_left: Nobody reads my notes with {name} away, and I miss it.
lines.friend_back: Welcome back, {name}. Your chart's up to date, and I'm glad you're here.
lines.common_medic: Ten years in a cancer centre, lining up beams to the millimetre. People in medicine never stop checking, and I can see you doing it too.
lines.common_radiation: Radiation was my whole working life, and I'm not afraid of the word. It's rare to meet somebody else who understands it properly.
lines.common_spanish: Spanish, at last! I can explain things properly now, without translating in my head.
lines.common_mexico: Mexican too, then? Tell me which city. I'm from Monterrey, and I'll tell you about my brother's tacos.
